source_summary: Ink-and-color landscape with a blue distant mountain and mist, pale water/shoreline strokes, two small brown sailboats, and a diagonal foreground bank of dark foliage and red-pink blossoms. Calligraphy and seals are excluded.

motifs.name: blue_distant_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the upper-left blue mountain mass with its flattened peak, dark indigo crown, and soft descending wash edges; exclude calligraphy and the separate foreground flower bank.
must_preserve: subtle tonal transition from dark peak to pale foot

motifs.name: low_mountain_mist_wash
motifs.description: Isolate the pale blue-gray mist and reflection-like wash hanging beneath the mountain on the left, including irregular wet edges and diluted pooling; exclude the darker mountain crest above.

motifs.name: distant_reed_shoreline
motifs.description: Isolate the low band of distant blue-gray shoreline or reeds across the left-middle water area, formed by short broken brush dabs and soft smudges.

motifs.name: pale_lake_horizon_lines
motifs.description: Isolate the faint gray horizontal lake and far-bank lines behind the boats, including thin wavering strokes and pale washes; exclude the sailboats, flowers, calligraphy, and seals.

motifs.name: paired_brown_sailboats
motifs.description: Isolate the two small brown sailboats near the center-right, including their triangular hull-and-sail silhouettes and thin upright masts; exclude surrounding foliage and water lines where possible.

motifs.name: right_blossom_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the dense flowering thicket at the right edge, with dark green-black foliage masses, red blossoms, yellow-green accents, and soft overlapping washes; exclude calligraphy and lower seal.
must_preserve: soft wet edges and clustered dabs

motifs.name: central_dark_flower_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the central diagonal embankment of mixed dark foliage and blossoms, including black pine-like strokes, blue-green washes, and red-pink flower clusters.

motifs.name: lower_left_blossom_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left continuation of the blossoming bank, with pale pink flowers, muted green leaves, yellow accents, and scattered dark brush marks along the diagonal slope.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
